title: Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem
description: Use this request to report other Non-Emergency signal concerns such as a partially blocked signal, a single signal bulb burned out, graffiti on a signal sign or control box and a broken pedestrian crossing button. *** For school zone flasher issues - use 'School Zone Flasher Maintenance - TPW' and Traffic Signal - Modification - TPW for signal timing issues. *** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business day.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a non-emergency traffic signal problem.
actions.why: For a non-emergency signal issue such as one burned-out bulb, a partially blocked signal, a broken or missing pedestrian crossing button, or graffiti on a signal sign or control box. The 311 request form asks which signal concern occurred and collects details such as the affected bulb or lane, street and travel direction, obstruction cause, graffiti location, or crossing direction.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem" requests does not apply to a burned-out red bulb when fewer than two signal heads are visible in the same direction of travel, school-zone flasher issues, traffic-signal timing or sync issues, or requests to install a new pedestrian crossing button. If graffiti is on a signal pole, then consider the "Code Concerns" 311 request suggested by the Dallas 311 website. If the issue is a school-zone flasher, then submit a "School Zone Flasher Maintenance" 311 request instead. If the request is for a new pedestrian crossing button or signal timing/modification, then submit a "Traffic Signal Timing and Modification" 311 request instead. If a red signal bulb is burned out and fewer than two signal heads are visible in the same direction of travel, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online and report a "Traffic Signal Head Turned or Not Visible" concern.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a new pedestrian crossing button or traffic-signal timing issue.
actions.why: For installing a pedestrian crossing button or changing an existing pedestrian crossing light, signal warning flasher, left-turn signal, thru/right-turn signal, or bicycle-lane signal. The 311 request form for "Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem" requests directs people seeking a new pedestrian button to "Traffic Signal - Timing/Modification"; the description directs timing issues there. The saved matching service is "Traffic Signal Timing and Modification," which has an online button and covers these modifications.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal Timing and Modification"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal Timing and Modification"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about graffiti on a traffic-signal pole.
actions.why: For graffiti on a traffic-signal pole. People who select On signal pole in the 311 request form see a Code Concerns suggestion. The public "Code Concerns" service has an online request form that includes graffiti concerns.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to maintain a school-zone flasher.
actions.why: For a school-zone flasher issue. The description for "Traffic Signal Maintenance - Report a Problem" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs school-zone flasher issues to "School Zone Flasher Maintenance - TPW". The public "School Zone Flasher Maintenance" service has an online request form for these concerns.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "School Zone Flasher Maintenance"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "School Zone Flasher Maintenance"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 by phone about a red signal bulb when fewer than two signal heads are visible.
actions.why: For a red signal bulb when fewer than two signal heads are visible in the same direction of travel. People who answer No to the two-or-more-visible-heads question are instructed to call 311 and report a "Traffic Signal - Signal Head Turned/Not Visible" request. The public "Traffic Signal Head Turned or Not Visible" guidance directs people to call 311 by phone for signal heads that motorists cannot see, multiple bulbs out, or conflicting colors.
actions.how: Call 311 and report a "Traffic Signal Head Turned or Not Visible" request
actions.how_formatted: Call [311](tel:311) and report a "Traffic Signal Head Turned or Not Visible" request
